label: Interferon-γ response
rationale: IFNγ-related transcription is part of the human active-TB whole-blood signature.
interpretation_limit: Biological mapping to a Hallmark response signature; the original paper did not use Hallmarks or establish cfRNA activation.

label: Interferon-α response
rationale: Type-I interferon-related transcription is part of the human active-TB whole-blood signature.
interpretation_limit: The gene-set score is not a measurement of circulating IFNα; the original paper did not use Hallmarks.

label: TNFα signaling via NF-κB
rationale: TB associated with TNF blockade supports the clinical relevance of TNF biology.
evidence_scope: Human clinical observations during TNF blockade
interpretation_limit: Conceptual mapping to the TNF/NF-κB Hallmark; the source did not measure NF-κB activity or pathway enrichment.

label: IL-6 / JAK / STAT3 signaling
rationale: IL6/IL10 co-expression and constitutive STAT3 phosphorylation were observed in human TB patients.
source_title: Harling et al., Cellular & Molecular Immunology 2019
interpretation_limit: Supports the biological axis, not an independently validated cfRNA Hallmark signal or an age interaction.

label: Inflammatory response
rationale: Inflammatory and chemotaxis transcription accompanied human TB blood abnormalities and responses of reference monocytes to patient plasma.
evidence_scope: Human patient blood and ex-vivo reference monocytes
source_title: Ahor et al., Journal of Infection 2024
interpretation_limit: The source combines blood and ex-vivo evidence; this is not independent validation of cfRNA enrichment.

label: Complement
rationale: Complement-related blood transcription and rising circulating immune complexes accompanied early HIV-associated TB.
interpretation_limit: Population and disease-stage context differ from this analysis; a higher score does not prove complement activation.
